sources.authors: Erik Demaine, Jason Ku, Justin Solomon
sources.scope: All seven pages, official browser lines 0-296, were freshly read, including all nine recurrence exercises and the preceding explicit sorting implementations.
sources.qualifications: The exercises state upper bounds when their toll is O rather than Theta. The source merge tie rule is unstable and its comments say decrement where counters actually increment; recurrence instruction is independent of those comments. Negative logarithmic-power thresholds are derived independently, not attributed to the stated nonnegative-k master case.

additionalReading.author: Tom Leighton, 9 October 1996
additionalReading.scope: All nine pages were freshly read in overlapping browser ranges 0-258 and 149-544. Original physical pages two and three were rendered and actually visually read.
additionalReading.qualifications: The second worked example on original page two incorrectly prints x^2 divided by log log x; its integrand is 1/(u log u), giving x^2 times log log x. The final lower-constant line on page three uses c2 where c1 is required. A polynomial derivative bound alone does not imply the stated multiplicative comparability. The theorem application retained in this lesson is unperturbed; the later perturbation proof is not treated as permission for arbitrary child-size maps.
